cases.requirement: All690 canonical pages and typed direct navigation remain unchanged in identity and semantics.
One documented authoritative per-KC package can be added without editing the generator.
A static noncurricular fixture renders through the real loader/composer, with correct pending/test state.
Authored body, research placeholders, review notes and alignment data survive two rebuilds and neighbouring updates.
Generated records are documented as derived; unsupported authored edits are rejected or preserved by explicit policy, never silently dropped.
One package edit changes only its content revision and relevant outputs; unchanged KC content/page outputs remain stable; shared indexes may update.
Per-KC review/alignment evidence binds to an exact content revision; an edit cannot inherit approval silently.
Static assets and optional module paths resolve beneath a non-root host prefix.
Only a lesson that needs an interactive module loads it; mount/reset/pause/dispose have observable repeatable behavior.
Malformed content, wrong KC identity or missing assets yields a precise error without replacing last good output with a false ready result.
Fixture content is explicitly noncurricular/test-only and never counted as approved teaching content or silently included in ordinary release.
Default unconfigured runtime links remain unavailable; fake ready metadata and enabled WRONG-KC actions fail independent validation.
Local-preview, missing index, endpoint-unverified and unsupported Lite bridge cases cannot produce ordinary classroom-ready actions.
Presentation puts the lesson near the start while preserving all direct top/bottom links and retains its mode during navigation.
All12 any_of cases show alternatives correctly in primary navigation and relevant reverse links; preserve raw graph metadata.
Search -> lesson -> Back leaves field values, visible rows and count consistent with or without restored page cache.
Copying, manual clipboard fallback and no-JavaScript static navigation still work at desktop and phone sizes.
Standalone export has honest source provenance without assuming an enclosing Git repository.
Deliver build/check/serve/fixture-preview/update instructions and evidence of add -> build -> edit -> rebuild -> verify.
No new pedagogical web research, actual lesson production, curriculum simulation, invented teacher/student feedback or learner-model work begins in this bounded follow-up.
